description: This file defines utility functions and test helpers for lazy tensor operations in PyTorch, including tensor conversions, comparisons, and device utilities, primarily used for testing or debugging.

methods.name: GetIgnoredCounters
methods.description: Returns a set of counters to ignore during testing or debugging.

methods.name: ToCpuTensor
methods.description: Converts a tensor on lazy device to a CPU tensor, handling both Variable and non-variable tensors.

methods.name: CopyToDevice
methods.description: Copies a tensor to a specified device.

methods.name: EqualValues
methods.description: Checks if two tensors have equal values.

methods.name: EqualValuesNoElementTypeCheck
methods.description: Checks if two tensors have equal values without checking element types.

methods.name: CloseValues
methods.description: Checks if two tensors are close within specified relative and absolute tolerances.

methods.name: void AllClose(at::Tensor tensor,at::Tensor xla_tensor,double rtol=1e-5,double atol=1e-8)
methods.description: Asserts that two tensors are close within tolerances.

methods.name: void AllEqual(at::Tensor tensor,at::Tensor xla_tensor)
methods.description: Asserts that two tensors have equal values.

methods.name: ForEachDevice
methods.description: Executes a function for each device available.

methods.name: GetTensorTextGraph
methods.description: Generates a text representation of a tensor's graph.

methods.name: GetTensorDotGraph
methods.description: Generates a dot format graph of a tensor.

methods.name: GetTensorHloGraph
methods.description: Generates an HLO (High Level Optimizer) graph representation of a tensor.

methods.name: TestBackward
methods.description: Performs backward pass testing on a set of input tensors and a test function.

methods.name: void AllClose(at::Tensor tensor,torch::lazy::LazyTensor & xla_tensor,double rtol=1e-5,double atol=1e-8)

ctags.name: AllEqual
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void AllEqual(at::Tensor tensor, at::Tensor xla_tensor) {$/
